cands.bio: Republican state representative for Alabama House District 81 since November 2018. Dadeville native and University of Alabama graduate. Served as an Army helicopter pilot, inspector general and air ambulance pilot for 15 years. Chaired the Military and Veterans' Affairs Committee in 2025-2026.
cands.gaps: We found no documented positions or actions from Ed Oliver on data centers, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. Ballotpedia's sponsored-bill list was empty in the copy we read, so we could not identify any bills he sponsored. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026. We found no controversies about him in the pages we had. His 2018 campaign is described only as focused on industrial development, economic growth and education, with no specifics.
